title: a --flag=value secret in args is refused naming the flag, never the value; case and leading dashes of the flag name do not matter
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.7 (never copy a literal secret into a launch file), extended to args
intent: An args element is secret when it follows a flag whose name holds key, token, secret, password, passwd or auth, or is --flag=value for such a flag. Nothing is written and Orca is not called.

## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Look at `src/sync.ts` and `docs/guide.md` and nothing outside the repo. Do not change any file.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
